PagerDuty: :rotating_light: ALERT: inference-gateway-prod-usw2 - error_rate(5m)=18% (threshold 8%) -> automatic page fired to rotation
SRE Bot: autoscaling metrics show spike in 502s from upstream auth proxy. 5xx spike started ~1799995480, CPU on gw-pods at 70% but latency up. link: https://grafana.company/r/inference-gw
Devon (oncall): ack. I'm on it, pulling logs now
SRE Bot: sample error: `proxy error: upstream reset during request` repeated across many buckets. KV-cache eviction rates also spiking.
Maria (prod-ops): any customer-facing impact yet? are embeddings / chat affected?
Devon (oncall): quick check - embeddings success rate down ~12% for a subset of requests, chat endpoints degraded but still returning 200s mostly. Some clients seeing increased timeouts.
Ops Lead: if upstream auth is failing we should route traffic off auth-heavy paths. Can we divert non-auth traffic to eu backup?
Devon (oncall): attempting two things: 1) scale inference-gw replicas + warm new pods, 2) shift 30% traffic to inference-gw-canary in eu-west (controlled weight). Doing scale first: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gw --replicas=8 -n prod`
SRE Bot: note from runbook step 3: if 5xx persists after scale, restart edge-proxy sidecars one-by-one to clear stuck connections.
Maria (prod-ops): customer comms: sending a brief to cs about intermittent 502s for embeddings; low severity for now but we should track SLA hit.
Devon (oncall): scaled to 8, new pods starting. running `kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-gw -n prod` now.
SRE Bot: new pods up, initial success rate improved to 10% error -> 7% in 2 minutes (below threshold). monitoring for 10m window.
Maria (prod-ops): thanks. I'm keeping customers updated. If we hold under threshold for 15m we can close the page and open a post-incident ticket.
Ops Lead: thumbs up. prepping rollback plan for recent auth proxy change (PR #432) in case this reoccurs.
Devon (oncall): still watching. I'll handoff to next oncall in 25m unless it flares.
PagerDuty: Pager acknowledged by Devon (oncall) at 1799995560
Devon (oncall): adding notes -> suspected root cause: upstream auth change + connection churn; follow-up: audit PR #432, add better backoff in proxy, add circuit breaker rule.
SRE Bot: captured logs and traces -> creating incident ticket INC-2026 with linked alerts and snapshots.
Maria (prod-ops): filing customer impact summary + timeline for postmortem.
Ops Lead: ok to close PD page if metrics stable for 15m, otherwise escalate to oncall-2.
Devon (oncall): marking this thread as monitoring. Will update again before handoff. :thumbsup:
